Student Fined for Protest, Police Later Withdraw Notice

A student from Greater Noida's Gautam Buddha University (GBU) faced a ₹5 lakh penalty notice for participating in a protest at Jantar Mantar. The notice was issued by Noida Police. Following social media backlash, the police later withdrew the notice. The student's organization, SFI, condemned the initial fine.
